verdict.rationale: Pylon provides multiple concrete AI-insight features on customer data: Ask AI for querying existing data, AI Reports for scheduled data summaries, AI Fields that roll up qualitative insights into structured fields with explainability, AI-generated followup tasks, and AI issue QA/rubrics — all operating directly on the product's own data. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no quantified accuracy/quality benchmarks for the insights.
